description: The plot titled “Massive Activation of atten_output_gate” illustrates how the maximum activation value varies across model layers for four signals. The x-axis is labeled “Layer,” uses a linear scale, and spans approximately layers 0 to 23 with tick labels shown at 0, 5, 10, 15, and 20. The y-axis is labeled “Max Activation Value,” uses a linear scale, and ranges from 0 to 400 with regularly spaced tick labels every 50 units. Four lines are shown: a blue dashed line labeled “attn_output,” which stays near low single-digit values through early layers, rises into the teens around the mid-to-late layers, and ends with a sharp increase to roughly ~110 at the final layer; an orange dotted line labeled “attn_residual,” which increases gradually from near 0 at the first layer to around ~50–60 by about layer 16, then climbs more steeply and finishes near ~260 at the last layer; a green dash-dot line labeled “attn_output_gate,” which remains close to 0 through much of the early layers, increases into the ~10–20 range in later layers, and ends with a sharp rise to roughly ~160 at the final layer; and a red solid line labeled “ffn_residual,” which starts near 0, increases steadily across layers (reaching roughly ~60 by around layer 16 and ~140–150 by around layer 21), and then rises sharply at the end to approximately ~390 at the final layer.
